CPS I/O Files

Provides async-friendly file I/O. Since Unix selectors cannot async-wait on regular files, this uses synchronous reads/writes with scheduleCallback to yield to the event loop between chunks.

Imports

../runtime, ../eventloop, streams

Types

FileStream = ref object of AsyncStream
